title: The kb-research skill and the coord MCP tools say a dedup holder and a claim key take the id pattern
goal: The kb-research skill's dedup step (.claude/skills/kb-research/SKILL.md, step 0) says --holder takes an id of letters, digits and _ . : / # @ - (a session id), not a free name, and kb_mcp.py's COORD_KEY description says the same of a key, since coord.py now exits 2 on any other, which step 0 reads as no store and skips dedup quietly. Found by the SP-5xnbspyp review (S4, BG-dn5n7z7k "A coord.py claim's free-text holder reaches every digest reader, past the references-only rule").

run:

s=open('.claude/skills/kb-research/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m=open('_tools/kb_mcp.py',encoding='utf-8').read()
a='a name of your own' not in s;k=[l for l in m.splitlines() if l.startswith('COORD_KEY')];b=bool(k) and 'letters' in k[0]

notes: The skill path is a plugin skill linked from the project's .claude/skills; check its real file before the claim. kb_mcp.py is code: it takes the code lane.
